decisions.statement: A whole-day event has no zone.
The event this answers with is reported as JSON.
An event named in place and as a flag is refused.
This reaches the calendar as Alan.
An update leaves every field the call does not name as that field is.
A start and an end are both a date alone or both a timestamp.
A zone is an IANA name rather than a raw offset.
A recurrence rule is said once over for each rule rather than parted by commas.
Everyone attending is emailed unless the call says who to email instead.
A call that threw after the calendar took the change says the calendar took it.
The attendees a call names take the place of whoever attends now.

definition: the command changing the fields a call names on one event
